itemdesc-strangecrystal: It hums against your palm. Bound into a book, it might tell you more. Set down, it stands like any crystal.
crystal-strike: Strike on a placed Unaligned crystal to make a Crystalline Chisel
itemdesc-seedling-glittering: A small glowing shard, humming faintly.
itemdesc-seedling-glowing: A brighter shard, humming steadily. It grows into a larger crystal.
blockdesc-crystal-unaligned-glittering-*: Glittering. Pale, nearly white, of no colour of its own.
blockdesc-crystal-unaligned-glowing-*: Glowing. A larger crystal, ivory and bright, still of no colour of its own.
blockdesc-crystal-fire-glittering-*: Glittering. Ruby red, warm to the touch.
blockdesc-crystal-fire-glowing-*: Glowing. A larger crystal, ruby red, warm to the touch.
blockdesc-crystal-ice-glittering-*: Glittering. Sapphire blue, cold to the touch.
blockdesc-crystal-ice-glowing-*: Glowing. A larger crystal, sapphire blue, cold to the touch.
blockdesc-crystal-earth-glittering-*: Glittering. Earthen brown and heavy for its size.
blockdesc-crystal-earth-glowing-*: Glowing. A larger crystal, earthen brown and heavy for its size.
blockdesc-crystal-sky-glittering-*: Glittering. Steely grey, light as a breath.
blockdesc-crystal-sky-glowing-*: Glowing. A larger crystal, steely grey, light as a breath.
crystal-charge-0: It is dim and quiet: empty.
crystal-charge-1: It glows a little: some charge.
crystal-charge-2: It glows well: half full or more.
crystal-cracks-1: A hairline crack runs through it.
crystal-cracks-2: Two cracks run through it. One more will shatter it.
